title: Retrieve and stably order every VCF 9.1 NSX Policy segment
prompt:
Finish `NsxPolicyClient.java`, a dependency-free, single-file Java 17 client for VCF 9.1 NSX Policy.

Before implementing, research the `ListAllInfraSegments` operation in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Confirm its method, path, Basic authentication, query parameters and bounds, cursor pagination, response model, and documented statuses, and cite the source URLs consulted.

Implement `listAllSegments(ListOptions)` so it retrieves the complete cursor-paginated collection. Send an authenticated GET to `/policy/api/v1/infra/segments` for every page with `Accept: application/json`, HTTP Basic authentication, no request body, and no `Content-Type`. Request `sort_ascending=true` and `sort_by=display_name` on every page, but still sort the combined result locally by ascending `display_name`, then `id`, then `path`. Follow every non-empty response cursor, including one returned with an empty `results` page. Stop only when the cursor is absent or empty. Detect any repeated cursor and throw `RepeatedCursorException` instead of looping.

`ListOptions` uses `null` for an unset option. Validate `pageSize` against the documented range 0 through 1000 and allow only `DVPortgroup` or `ALL` as a non-empty `segmentType`; validation failures must happen before any request. Re-send all set caller options on every continuation request. An empty optional string is treated as unset. Omit the first-page `cursor` and every unset optional query field rather than sending an empty value. An explicitly supplied `false` for `includeMarkedForDeleteObjects` must still be sent. Build query fields in this order when present: `cursor`, `include_mark_for_delete_objects`, `included_fields`, `page_size`, `segment_type`, `sort_ascending`, `sort_by`. Form-encode every query value.

Return useful `IOException`s for non-2xx responses and malformed response JSON. Use only the Java standard library and keep the implementation in the existing single source file.

Do not modify `tests/TestMain.java`, `tests/mock_nsx.py`, or `tests/verify.py`. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`.

catalog.domain: a paginated collection that must be retrieved completely and emitted in a stable order
catalog.constraint: asserts the exact request wire shape, including that unset optional fields are omitted rather than sent empty
